field_evidence.description: Official MPS AntiSocialBehaviour dataset with ASB incidents classified under Personal, Nuisance and Environmental qualifiers.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official Metropolitan Police Service AntiSocialBehaviour dataset. The dataset classifies ASB under Personal, Nuisance and Environmental qualifiers and exposes fields including ASB Calls, Hours, Date, Boroughs, Response Time, Call Type and wards. The current published CSV covers May 2025 through April 2026 under Open Government Licence v2. This batch binds Campden as the target ward, retaining verified ward code E05009390 as the crosswalk key; ward-row extraction, parcel spatial join and materialization are deferred to local OpenCode, so no ASB rows or parcel progress are claimed.
